completeness.why: getDateWithSkippedWeekend now takes the enable flag and mode and decides both whether and how to move the date; getNextDate passes its parsed skipWeekend/weekendSolve and keeps only its own noSkipWeekend option (a variation only that site has), getUpcomingDates passes its config fields, and both schedule-template occurrences pass their dateConditions fields to getDayWithSkippedWeekend, which wraps the shared function and owns the day-string conversion.

interface.why: The flag and mode are parameters for the real variation and each caller maps its own field name (weekendSolve vs weekendSolveMode), with noSkipWeekend kept explicit at getNextDate; the day-string wrapper is justified by two callers but redundantly re-checks skipWeekend before delegating to a function that now checks it too.

disguised_duplication.where: The site-level ternaries are removed, not reshaped; the only leftover is the redundant skipWeekend guard in getDayWithSkippedWeekend (shared/schedules.ts), which repeats the check inside getDateWithSkippedWeekend but is shared, not a disguised site copy.
